reviews.comment: Great professor for first semester studio. He's evidently very knowledgeable about both rhino and architecture in general, although you have to ask him for specific help on projects in order to get the most out of his feedback. He often recommends you look into precedents that fit your design which really helps.

Had him for one project. He's nice and connects well with students, but communication can be spotty and individual critiques are very minimal,  lots of nodding. Classes were often canceled or moved to Zoom, and he seemed to lose steam near the end. His timeliness seemed unorganized.  Great with Rhino, but stay proactive and ahead on deadlines.

I wouldn't have rather wanted anyone else as my 1st yr prof! I took him for both semesters because I enjoyed the level at which he was preparing us for the years to come. He respects his students and takes our work seriously while keeping a fun learning environment. You will gain so many important skills and learn so much in his studio!

Great prof who's down to earth. He will always keep it real with you and also help you when you're confused. He gives clear instructions, and the lectures he gives on side topics are always cool. Great prof to have as a first-year student, I feel like I learned so much and made so much progress this semester, and it's thanks to Hans for that.
He is very knowledgeable about other architects and will give you reading assignments. Do not wait till the last minute to do them. He gives great feedback, an is overall a great professor!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Hilarious

reviews.comment: live laugh love Hans, he's funny, he gives good music recs. If you hate your work, he actually helps you. he hates responding to emails, but he will follow up with you in person. Once he got up at 2 am because we asked him to check our work online, even though he taught an 8 am the next day, and I feel like that says a lot about him
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Hans is definently a good professor to take for a first year architecture student. His classes are very layed back and chill. He does give ok feedback but he mainly relies on you to figure out stuff on your own and not to critique you too much. He was very funny and vibes were very good and entertaining in his class. I would for sure take again

He is really a good professor & makes sure you have a good standing for your first semester. He really is passionate about his projects and it shows. However, his grading sometimes has critiques that he didn't warn you about in the process of your project, so its kinda discouraging. He seemed to really be done with some of the kids in our class.

Pros: He's a chill, funny guy, and gives good criticism & feedback. He's also a Rhino wizard, which is extremely helpful if you're stuck or suffering with Rhino. 

Cons: Sometimes it scares me when I'm talking about my design, and he's just nodding or silent for too long. Also, message him or tell him in person about stuff, no emails.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This professor does give good feedback when he looks over your projects, but you need to ask questions upfront otherwise you don't know what you're doing. He's very understanding and wants you to think outside of the box to explore your thought process and design. He does not answer emails so talk to him in person. It's not an easy class so try

Genuinely my first TAMU class that I've actually enjoyed after 2 years being here. He's a chiller if you are. Go to class. Do your (own) work. Give effort. He's got very good insight and isn't afraid to ruffle some feathers if you're wrong (which will be the case a lot of the time. It's your first studio). Don't be prideful, listen to reason.
So far a great 2 days, although the powerpoint presentations went long
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Hans is the goat he taught me everything I know. Best 6 or 7 weeks of my life.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Hans is the goat he taught me how to boolean union on that thang

Professor Steffes was incredibly helpful and supportive. He pushed us to think critically and approach design with intention. His feedback was always insightful and encouraging, helping me grow both technically and creatively. I truly learned a lot and felt inspired in his class. Great proffesor, I reccommend him!

Overall, Professor Hans dedication, knowledge, and inspirational teaching make them a valuable asset to the academic community and a profound influence on their students' educational journeys.

In the classroom, Professor Hans combines deep expertise with a dynamic teaching style. Make sure you show up to class evreydAY

He wasn't too bad, just make sure you show up to class on time and everyday. You have to ask for more critical help, but he does answer your question eventually. Don't expect an email back either. He was cool.
Great professor and cool guy to be around. Overall very straight forward with you and your project, but for sure gets you to expand your mind. I will be taking him again!

Really good prof. Had him as a first year and learned a lot. He values self exploration, but will give his opinion freely. Encourages students personal growth and pushes them to preform at higher levels. He was great at encouraging a work life balance and was very understanding when issues arouse. Ask questions, don't wait for him to come to you.

Hans is an incredible professor who engages well with students, encourages creativity, and brings about new ideas of thinking. He is very understanding, has new ways of thinking, and shows genuine interest in concepts being taught. Without a doubt would recommend taking him as a professor.

Professor was very clear on what was required from us. The computer programs were taught well, and he always answered any question and emails that were about the material. He made sure everyone was actively improving and learning from the projects. I highly recommend him; he is always willing to do what is best for you.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Although he's an easier grader, he is incredibly vague and does not teach well. Although he will suggest changes in your design, he provides very little explanation as to why. Very unorganized, doesn't respond to most emails, sometimes comes across as condescending despite giving poor advice. Don't take if you actually want to learn.

would not recommend .. felt behind from other studio sections. nice to have an easy grader for first semester of studio but he does not teach well or explain how to use programs well for someone who has never used any of the softwares before. very knowledgeable about architecture just not a good teacher
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things
